title: Rabbi Birim
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 55b: “Rav Nachum said that Rabbi Birim said in the name of an elder — and who is he? Rabbi Bana’ah.” In Chullin 98a: “Rabbi Nachum said that Rabbi Biryim said in the name of an elder, and Rabbi Yaakov is his name.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Berakhot 55b fully writes Rav Nachum, whereas Chullin 98a fully writes Rabbi Nachum. Those full forms support the two contextual expansions of Hyman’s abbreviated title; the Birim/Biryim forms and the two different named elders are retained.

The checked Berakhot 55b chain has Rav Nachum, Rabbi Birim and Rabbi Bena’ah; the checked Chullin 98a chain has Rabbi Nachum, Rabbi Biryim and Rabbi Yaakov. Both full-title contexts and the two different elders are retained; the chains are not harmonized.
